title: Many Nations Destroyed, and the Spider's Weak Home

paragraphs.text: Allah gave Abraham Isaac and Jacob, and He placed prophethood and scripture among his descendants. Lot warned his people about a shameful sin that no one had done before. They also blocked the roads and did evil in their meetings, yet they dared him to bring Allah's punishment. When Allah's messengers came to Abraham with good news, they told him they would destroy Lot's city. Abraham reminded them that Lot lived there, and they replied that they would save Lot and his family, except his wife. When they reached Lot, he was upset and worried for them, but they comforted him and announced that punishment would fall from the sky. Its remains are a clear sign for people who think.

Shu'ayb told the people of Madyan to worship Allah, to expect the Last Day and to stop spreading corruption. They denied him, so an earthquake struck them and left them lying dead in their homes. Aad and Thamud were also destroyed, and their ruined homes can still be seen. Qarun, Pharaoh and Haman were arrogant, although Moses had brought them clear proofs. Each nation was punished for its sin, some by a storm of stones, some by a blast, some by being swallowed by the earth and some by drowning. Allah did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
Those who take protectors other than Allah are like a spider that builds a home, and the spider's home is the weakest of all homes. Only people of knowledge truly understand such examples.
